name: api-error-fails-flow-with-500
description: An API status >= 400 fails the Mule http:request (default success-status-code-validator 0..399); the unhandled exception makes the listener answer 500.

source.reference: proxying-a-rest-api/src/main/app/proxying-a-rest-api.xml (http:request without success-status-code-validator, no exception strategy); Mule 3.8 HTTP connector docs: default success range 0..399, failures raise ResponseValidatorException → 500
